Extracted PDF content, excluding only the Figure 1 label block whose spatial ordering changed, is identical to the backup, including the caption, body, tables and scientific numbers; the abstract is identical and remains five sentences. First citations remain strictly [1] through [17]: [1]-[5] in Introduction on page 1, [6]-[12] in Section II.A on page 1, [13]-[14] in the GLAD paragraph on page 2, [15]-[16] in Section II.D on page 2, and [17] in Scope and limitations on page 5.
